world.name: Nebryss
world.location: Edge of the Imperium Nihilus, isolated by violent warp storms and shifting mist barriers.
world.geography: A vast ocean world broken into floating island archipelagos, towering volcanic spires, and submerged continental shelf ruins. Swirling mist zones hover over the waters, forming natural currents and aerial trade corridors.
world.theMist: A unique warp-adjacent atmospheric matrix. Neither purely natural nor aligned with Chaos, the mist carries extreme psychic conductivity, reality distortions, and mistborn beasts, while simultaneously powering mist-reactors.
world.privateNotes:
CAMPAIGN GM SECRET:
Nebryss is built over an ancient dormant Xenos planetary construct—an artificial world-shield engineered millions of years ago. The mist is the living breath of a dormant psychic core known as 'The Mistheart'. Awakening the core will either seal all warp rifts in the Nihilus sector or dissolve the archipelago into raw warp essence.

mistTradeRoutes.description: Formed by stabilized mist channels, these corridors allow airships and mist-adapted vessels to cross the oceanic expanses between island hubs.
mistTradeRoutes.importance: Controlling trade corridors grants economic hegemony over Mistral coin circulation and mist-engine fuel distribution.

currency.name: Mistral Coin (₥)
currency.appearance: Forged from a shimmering, mist-resistant alloy. One side bears intricate swirling mist glyphs, while the reverse features the golden spires of Zephyria.
currency.value: Mistrals are accepted across all major hubs, though value fluctuates depending on route safety, mist density, and faction trade embargoes.
currency.privateNotes:
CAMPAIGN GM SECRET:
10% of physical Mistral coins minted in Luminos contain microscopic silver-line vox-bugs used by Gilded Accord intelligence to track wealthy merchants and rebel operatives.

usage.physicalCoins: Circulated heavily in frontier ports, rebel outposts, and pirate harbors where digital net connections are unreliable.
usage.digitalTransactions: Processed via high-frequency encrypted datapads in Zephyria and Luminos through the central Nebryssian Reserve.

currency.culturalSignificance: The coin symbolizes the delicate interdependence between Nebryssian factions and the shared reliance on mist navigation.

chroniclesOfNebryss.era: I. Age of Discovery & Rogue Trader Charters (M39)
chroniclesOfNebryss.summary: Imperial Explorator fleets under House Voss chart the Nebryss archipelago, discovering bioluminescent mist zones and ancient stone monoliths.
chroniclesOfNebryss.privateNotes:
GM SECRET:
House Voss discovered that the Whispering Stones responded to psychic resonance, granting early navigators supernatural control over fog corridors. The Voss family hid these findings from the Mechanicus to maintain a trade monopoly.

chroniclesOfNebryss.era: II. The Great Mist Trade Wars (M41.800)
chroniclesOfNebryss.summary: A decades-long war between independent island barons and merchant cartels that led to the foundation of the Gilded Accord and the minting of the Mistral Coin.
chroniclesOfNebryss.privateNotes:
GM SECRET:
The war ended when the merchant lords secretly sabotaged rival airship fleets using unstable mist-engine overcharges, masking the sabotage as natural mist anomalies.

chroniclesOfNebryss.era: III. The Heresy of Seraphine Voss & Inquisitorial Decree (M42.010)
chroniclesOfNebryss.summary: Lady Seraphine Voss is declared a traitor by the Ordo Hereticus after accusations of forbidden warp experimentation and illicit trade with Xenos and Corsairs.
chroniclesOfNebryss.privateNotes:
GM SECRET:
Seraphine Voss discovered an ancient stasis vault containing the original Warrant of Trade and a map to the planetary Mistheart. She went rogue to prevent the Inquisition from weaponizing the core.

chroniclesOfNebryss.summary: A tense 5-way conflict between the Imperium, NLR, Gilded Accord, Abyssal Cabal, and Crimson Corsairs for total domination of the archipelago.
chroniclesOfNebryss.privateNotes:
GM SECRET:
The mist density is increasing exponentially across all sectors. In less than one solar cycle, the mist will trigger a planetary surge, forcing all factions into an all-out war for survival.

densityLevels.silvershadeMist: Light, translucent mist. Provides 100% engine efficiency and safe navigation.
densityLevels.bioluminescentMist: Glowing blue/green fog. Empowers Mistweavers and mist-reactors but induces mild psychic echoes.
densityLevels.abyssalFog: Dense purple/black vapors. Causes hull corrosion, sensory distortion, and hallucinations.
densityLevels.ethericWarpSurge: Violent warp-infused fog storm. Reality fractures, allowing daemonic entities to physically manifest.

mistEffects.navigation: Captains prefer flying above the mist layer, dipping below only for stealth ambushes or emergency refueling.
mistEffects.privateNotes:
CAMPAIGN GM SECRET:
Mistweavers who perish while channeling dense mist do not die completely—their consciousness dissolves into the mist matrix, becoming part of the ancestral voices heard in the Grove of Echoes.

mistWeavingTechnology.overview: An ancient spiritual art practiced exclusively by the Nebryssian Liberation Republic, channeling mist vapors into defensive fog barriers and offensive constructs.

howItWorks.ritualsAndSacrifice: Mistweavers conduct rhythmic chants using ancestral bone-charms and mist-condensers to shape the fog.

temporaryMistZones.escape: Creates opaque fog banks allowing NLR guerrilla squads to vanish without a trace.
temporaryMistZones.ambush: Isolates enemy flagships inside blinding vapor pockets, cutting off communication.

limitationsAndRisks.psychicStrain: Overusing mist-weaving inflicts severe mental fatigue and gradual mist-sickness.
limitationsAndRisks.culturalSecrecy: Guarded under pain of death by NLR shamans to prevent Imperial acquisition.

flyingShipsAndMistEngines.description: The foundation of travel across Nebryss. Mist engines convert raw mist vapors into antigravity lift and propulsion.

mistEngines.gildedAccordsRole: The Mistforges of Zephyria and Luminos manufacture 40% of all certified mist engines.
mistEngines.otherFactions: The remaining 60% are customized by independent shipwrights, rebel mechanics, and pirate riggers.

optimizationCategories.speed: Stripped hull plating and overloaded thrusters for rapid interceptors.
optimizationCategories.endurance: Heavy-duty condensers and extra fuel cells for trans-oceanic voyages.
optimizationCategories.cargoCapacity: Expanded cargo holds for merchant galleons and bulk ore carriers.

weapons.description: A unique hybrid of Imperial gunpowder, mist-plasma technology, and chain-weapons.

technologyAndInfrastructure.privateNotes:
CAMPAIGN GM SECRET:
The Gilded Accord has secretly developed a prototype 'Mist-Nullifier' engine capable of dissipating NLR mist barriers instantaneously.

dailyLife.settlements: Spans from stone cliff fortresses and rustic treehouse canopy villages to glowing floating sky-cities.
dailyLife.transportation: Airships, steam-skiffs, and coastal barges for water travel; armored mounts and flightless birds for island terrain.
dailyLife.faithAndCulture: Divided between strict Imperial Creed devotion, NLR ancestral mist-reverence, and Cabal warp worship.

factions.name: The Imperium of Man
factions.role: Military crusade force seeking to subjugate Nebryss under Imperial compliance.
goals: Eradicate heresy, Chaos cults, and rebel insurgencies.
Establish absolute Imperial tithe control over mist trade routes.
Locate and purge all remnants of the Voss Rogue Trader dynasty.
challenges: Severed supply lines due to Imperium Nihilus warp isolation.
Fierce guerilla resistance from the NLR and piratical harassment from Corsairs.
factions.mistKnowledge: Views the mist as a dangerous warp anomaly to be purged or controlled through Mechanicus technology.
factions.privateNotes:
CAMPAIGN GM SECRET:
Inquisitor Vontis Mortis is secretly hunting for the Voss Warrant of Trade to claim its ancient imperial privileges for his own inquisitorial cabal.

notableOrganizations.name: White Consuls Expeditionary Chapter
notableOrganizations.description: Elite Space Marine peacekeeping contingent providing tactical command and vanguard assault forces.

notableOrganizations.name: Ordo Hereticus Inquisition Cell
notableOrganizations.description: Shadowy inquisitorial tribunal investigating heresy, psyker mutations, and rogue trader treason.

factions.name: The Gilded Accord
factions.role: Mercantile federation of wealthy city-states, banks, and technology guilds.
factions.neutrality: Maintains armed neutrality, supplying mist engines, weapons, and bank loans to all warring factions.
factions.peopleIdentity: Citizens identify strongly with their home sky-city (e.g., Zephyrians, Luminosians).
goals: Monopolize the minting and trade of Mistral Coins.
Keep the five-way war balanced so no single faction dominates the archipelago.
factions.privateNotes:
CAMPAIGN GM SECRET:
The Accord's ruling council secretly pays protection tithes to Crimson Corsair captains to raid Imperial supply convoys, ensuring the Imperium remains reliant on Accord trade.

notableOrganizations.name: The Fogbound Cartographers
notableOrganizations.description: Elite guild of master navigators who map shifting mist routes and sell navigation charts.

notableOrganizations.name: The Nebryssian Reserve
notableOrganizations.description: Central banking institution controlling physical and digital currency reserves.

factions.name: The Nebryssian Liberation Republic
factions.role: Native islander alliance and guerilla resistance movement fighting for planetary sovereignty.
factions.mistKnowledge: Reveres the mist as a sacred ancestral spirit matrix and practices the art of Mistweaving.
factions.peopleIdentity: Proudly call themselves Nebryssians, considering external factions as invaders.
goals: Expel Imperial forces and Cabal cultists from Nebryss.
Preserve ancestral Mistweaver sanctuaries and bioluminescent groves.
Establish an independent republic across all island chains.
challenges: Resource scarcity and technological disparity against Imperial war machines.
High mortality rate among Mistweaver shamans due to psychic strain.
factions.privateNotes:
CAMPAIGN GM SECRET:
NLR high command is hiding a surviving descendant of House Voss in Misthaven, using their bloodline seal to access ancient orbital defense stations.

factions.name: The Abyssal Cabal
factions.role: Dread alliance of Chaos cultists, daemon-forges, and warp-corrupted warlords.
factions.mistKnowledge: Exploits the mist's warp conductivity to open daemon rifts and forge warp-tainted wargear.
goals: Ignite the mist into a permanent warp storm across the entire planet.
Destroy Fortress Sanctus and sacrifice Imperial commanders to Chaos gods.
factions.privateNotes:
CAMPAIGN GM SECRET:
Cabal High Sorcerers are constructing a massive blood-altar on Maledictum Prime designed to siphon the souls of fallen Mistweavers.

factions.name: The Crimson Corsairs
factions.role: Piratical fleet syndicate raiding mist trade lanes and plundering isolated outposts.
factions.tactics: Hit-and-run ambushes from dense fog banks using stealth skiffs and cloaked flagships.
factions.culture: Bound by a ruthless Pirate Code, led by notorious captains like Lady Seraphine [REDACTED].
factions.privateNotes:
CAMPAIGN GM SECRET:
The Corsairs hold the missing logbooks of the flagship 'The Deathless Dream', detailing the exact coordinates of the stasis vault holding the Voss Warrant of Trade.

struggleForNebryss: The Imperium of Man fights to enforce absolute Imperial compliance.
The Nebryssian Liberation Republic wages guerilla war for total planetary independence.
The Abyssal Cabal seeks to ignite the mist into a nightmare warp rift.
The Gilded Accord manipulates economic trade to profit from endless conflict.
The Crimson Corsairs plunder wealth and secret charters across the mist lanes.
The Mist itself is awakening—its dormant psychic core responding to the bloodshed.

storyHooks.name: The Sky Bazaar Conspiracy
storyHooks.premise: A covert plot inside Zephyria's Sky Bazaar threatens to crash the Mistral currency.
storyHooks.keyElements: Insider trading, black-market ciphers, high-stakes assassination attempts.
storyHooks.potentialImpact: Destabilizes Gilded Accord neutrality and ignites economic panic.
storyHooks.privateNotes: GM SECRET: The conspiracy is orchestrated by a rogue Accord consul working for the Abyssal Cabal.

storyHooks.name: The Missing Voss Charter
storyHooks.premise: Rumors surface of a sealed stasis casket containing the original Voss Warrant of Trade floating inside a mist-wreck.
storyHooks.keyElements: Race against Imperial inquisitors, Corsair raiders, and Cabal sorcerers.
storyHooks.potentialImpact: Grants the holder immense legal authority and access to hidden orbital defense vaults.
storyHooks.privateNotes: GM SECRET: The charter is guarded by an automated ancient Mechanicus sentinel that responds only to Voss blood.

storyHooks.name: The Mistforge Sabotage
storyHooks.premise: A series of mysterious plasma overcharges threatens to detonate Zephyria's main mist-reactors.
storyHooks.keyElements: Time-sensitive investigation, sabotaged cooling conduits, hidden double agents.
storyHooks.potentialImpact: Could send the floating capital plunging into the ocean abyss.
storyHooks.privateNotes: GM SECRET: The sabotage is designed to force the Accord into signing an exclusive war treaty with the Imperium.

mistBasedGameplayMechanics.name: Mist Density Effects
mistBasedGameplayMechanics.description: Denser mist boosts engine thrust and mist-weaving power but increases anomaly risks and warp surges.

mistBasedGameplayMechanics.name: Mist Anomalies & Hallucinations
mistBasedGameplayMechanics.description: Random tactical events in fog zones (e.g., ghostly ship phantoms, vox distortions, warp rifts).

mistBasedGameplayMechanics.name: Mistweaving Sacrifices
mistBasedGameplayMechanics.description: NLR Mistweavers can summon opaque fog shields or mist constructs at the cost of Wounds or APL.

potentialEndgameScenarios.name: The Awakening of the Mistheart
potentialEndgameScenarios.description: The players locate the dormant Xenos core beneath Nebryss and decide whether to activate its planetary shield or destroy it.
potentialEndgameScenarios.privateNotes: GM SECRET: Activating the shield permanently seals Nebryss from the Warp, isolating it from both the Imperium and Chaos forever.

potentialEndgameScenarios.name: The Inquisitorial Purge of House Voss
potentialEndgameScenarios.description: Inquisitor Vontis Mortis launches a full planetary purge to eliminate all claimants to the Voss Warrant of Trade.
potentialEndgameScenarios.privateNotes: GM SECRET: Players can choose to aid the Inquisition, protect the Voss line, or claim the Warrant for themselves.

potentialEndgameScenarios.name: The Fall of Zephyria
potentialEndgameScenarios.description: The floating sky-city is besieged by Cabal armadas and Imperial blockades in a catastrophic final battle.
potentialEndgameScenarios.privateNotes: GM SECRET: The players' actions during the battle determine which faction claims the city's central vault.
